tldr: Sun in the 7th house: identity and vitality center on partnership and one-to-one bonds
body: Sun in the 7th house: identity and vitality center on partnership and one-to-one bonds. Gift: you shine there. Watch: ego tied to it. With the Sun in the 7th house, identity, vitality, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center move through partnership, marriage, clients, contracts, and open conflict. This makes how you meet others, let yourself be met, and handle equality in relationship a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose. Left unconscious, it can become over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through one-to-one bonds.
challenge: over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth concentrated in one-to-one bonds.
